verdict.rationale: AnyDesk's docs mention an official open-source Python module for its REST API that includes scripts and templates, for example to export session data. That is the closest thing to an official SDK, but it is thinly described. The REST API and CLI alone are interfaces, not SDKs, and earn no credit. Missing for 10: a documented multi-language SDK family, SDK reference docs and install/versioning details, a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
